design_baseline: calendar0917/research@a269d14 (BOSI v0 report + NO_GO for relation allocation)

reused_frozen_artifacts.rule: read-only; every reused file is sha256-verified before it enters an analysis; no pre-existing model is ever run on Locked again

data.relation_cache_rebuild: none: the v0 cache is reused read-only and verified by content hash

architecture.name: BOSI-v1-P (BOSI v0 body, partner-content null arm)
architecture.initialisation: atom/bond encoders from the frozen train-only masked-SSL checkpoint; every other module from the single shared seed stream (arm never consumes RNG)

arms.B_v0: M_B[r] = n[r]/max(deg-1,1) * sum_{f!=e} T_k(x[v,f])  (frozen historical runs, not retrained)
arms.P: M_P[r] = n[r] * T_k(x[v,e])  (the only new arm)
arms.R_v0: M_R[r] = sum_{f!=e, rel=r} T_k(x[v,f])  (background only, not retrained)

recipe.normalisation: fit_only_norm over the 8000 Fit8k rows; identical arrays for every arm

gpu.execution: sequential on one GPU (avoids the ~20% parallel-contention overhead measured in v0)

decision_rules.delta_definition: Delta = MAE(P) - MAE(B); positive means partner content is useful
decision_rules.PARTNER_CONTENT_SUPPORTED: Delta > 0 on both seeds, seed-mean Delta >= 0.005, ordinary and top-10-removed deltas share the sign; if any_unseen does not benefit, the report must say the content has predictive value but does not solve unseen-structure generalisation
decision_rules.PARTNER_CONTENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Delta small, seed-unstable, or 95% CI crosses zero; equivalence may not be claimed and no further model may be justified by 'partner moments are the key contribution'
decision_rules.SIMPLER_BODY_PROMISING: Delta < 0 on both seeds with seed-mean |Delta| >= 0.005 and not tail-dominated; then simplify further instead of adding attention

analysis.support_source: Fit8k only; exact typed radius-2 rooted signatures (same construction as v0)
analysis.top10_sensitivity: drop the 10 molecules with the largest max(AE_A, AE_B) for each pair
analysis.bootstrap: paired over fixed Locked molecules, 10000 resamples; descriptive of molecule sampling only, it cannot represent training randomness
analysis.checkpoint_reporting: best_monitor primary; final auxiliary; Monitor and Fit reported for every arm

forbidden: official test or official valid access
using Monitor or Locked labels for architecture / hyper-parameter / epoch / seed selection beyond the declared Monitor rule
widening the network, adding moment orders, changing relation types, changing normalisation, or rescaling one arm's statistics to rescue it
launching any SSL job in this round
